text_block_list.text:
Together with Gold Ship, I managed to 
survive our first three years.

Just as I was thinking of sharing these 
joyful tidings with her—
(KABOOOOOOOOOOM!!!!)

Suddenly, a ferocious sound of destruction 
echoed, and a massive tremor shook the 
area...!!

I have absolutely no idea what's going 
on!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Trainer! Fine day for construction, 
ain't it!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What are you so surprised about? It's just 
a bit of DIY.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Early this morning, while I was 
free-climbing the school building's wall, 
I happened to run into the Don—"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
They told us, "Congratulations!" Guess we 
really made the most of these three years 
together.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"If we're gonna keep gettin' along, we 
might as well make this place more 
comfortable to live in, right?"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And so, I'm gonna go grab a huge tank for 
the sea anemone for now.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...What's your problem?

There's a mountain of things to call out 
here, but first off—
choice_data_list:
Is it really okay to do construction 
without permission...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, don't worry—I got permission from 
the Don."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I mean, you oughta get used to it pretty 
soon.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"We're gonna keep climbing this mountain 
called the Umamusume world together."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
If you get startled by every little thing, 
your heart's not gonna hold out. Get 
yourself an iron-clad mindset.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Got it? Then don't go bringing a fish tank 
next time!

While taken aback by the sheer 
unpredictability of her actions—

"I'm so glad to know you want to keep 
walking together with me...!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hm, what's this? ...It won't fit in the 
tank.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey Trainer, give me a hand!

There seem to be plenty of things to worry 
about... Well, let's just do our best!
